title: Dynamical regimes of QAOA gradient response
summary: Characterizing the trainability of the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) requires understanding how its gradient landscape changes across circuit parameters and problem size. Yet these gradients are usually described in terms of the native QAOA angles, making it difficult to distinguish parameter specific features from broader changes in the underlying circuit dynamics.
